businessProfile.productSummary: Handcrafted, custom-fit Italian leather handbags sold DTC to affluent shoppers seeking artisanal luxury.

assumptions: This is a direct-to-consumer, consumer-facing product (not B2B).

selectedPersonas.whyRelevant: Affluent Classic shoppers (age 50-68, low price sensitivity) value craftsmanship, heritage, and longevity — directly aligned with Italian-made, handcrafted, custom-fit handbags and likely able to afford $1,200.
selectedPersonas.keyMessage: Timeless Italian craftsmanship: a made-to-measure leather handbag handcrafted in Florence for a lifetime of wear.

selectedPersonas.whyRelevant: The Gifter mode captures higher-AOV buyers looking for impressive, giftable items; the publisher notes (Northbed/Hearthstone) show gifting and life-event drivers that can trigger high-ticket purchases.
selectedPersonas.keyMessage: The perfect, show-stopping heirloom gift — beautifully presented, made-to-order in Florence (order now for thoughtful delivery).

selectedPersonas.whyRelevant: The Sustainability Buyer (25-45) is attracted to supply-chain transparency and ethical production; if the brand supports traceability or artisanal, small-batch production, this persona will respond despite the luxury price.
selectedPersonas.keyMessage: Artisan-made and traceable: responsibly sourced leather and transparent Florentine craftsmanship built to last.

variants.headline: Made‑to‑measure leather handbags, handcrafted in Florence
variants.body: A custom-fit leather handbag, handcrafted in Florence using time-honored Italian techniques. Designed with durable construction and classic lines for a lifetime of wear; minimum order ships in 6 weeks.
variants.rationale: Emphasizes craftsmanship, Italian heritage, custom fit and longevity—directly addressing this persona’s preference for understated, quality-first purchases.

variants.headline: The perfect heirloom gift — custom Italian handbag
variants.body: A show-stopping, made-to-order leather handbag handcrafted in Florence. Order now to allow the six-week craft time and ensure thoughtful delivery for your occasion — an heirloom designed to impress.
variants.rationale: Positions the bag as an impressive, made-to-order heirloom and clearly states the manufacture lead time so gifters can plan delivery.

variants.headline: Artisan-made, made-to-order handbags — inquire about sourcing
variants.body: Handcrafted in Florence on a made-to-order schedule to avoid overproduction; leather construction built to last. Contact us for details on leather origin and Florentine workshop practices; minimum order ships in 6 weeks.
variants.rationale: Stresses reduced overproduction and offers supply-chain transparency by inviting sourcing questions, aligning with this persona’s demand for specific, verifiable information.

bidStrategy.rationale: Considered purchase at ~$1200 AOV: bid to a target CPA of 20-35% of order value so first-order economics stay profitable

budget.rationale: $1500/publisher/month floor for statistically useful volume × 5 publishers × 1.5 luxury-tier multiplier
